description: Returns the next bank (public) holiday for a region, and today's holiday if today is one (today_holiday), with the number of days until the next one. Dates are ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD) and local to the region. England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland have different bank holidays, so choose the right region. Call list_regions for the valid country and region keys. Free for 100 calls per client per UTC day, then $0.001 USDC per call via x402.

country.description: Country key from list_regions, e.g. gb, ie, fr, de, es.

lang.description: Language for holiday and region names. Default en.

region.description: Region key from list_regions, e.g. scotland, england.

name: next_bank_holiday
title: Next bank holiday
